definitions.explanation: An artificial replacement for a missing hand or arm. Ranges from simple cosmetic devices to sophisticated electronic prosthetics.

examples.japanese: {義手|ぎしゅ}を{付|つ}けている。
examples.english: He is wearing a prosthetic hand.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}の{義手|ぎしゅ}は{指|ゆび}を{自由|じゆう}に{動|うご}かすことができる。
examples.english: The latest prosthetic hands can move their fingers freely.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{片腕|かたうで}を{失|うしな}ったが、{義手|ぎしゅ}を{使|つか}って{日常生活|にちじょうせいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: He lost an arm in an accident, but he uses a prosthetic arm for daily life.

notes:
USAGE:
{義手|ぎしゅ} literally means "righteous hand" — the character {義|ぎ} here means "substitute" or "artificial" (as in {義理|ぎり} meaning social obligation). This {義|ぎ} prefix is used for various prosthetics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義手|ぎしゅ}を{付|つ}ける (to put on a prosthetic hand)
- {義手|ぎしゅ}を{装着|そうちゃく}する (to wear/fit a prosthetic — formal)
- {電動|でんどう}{義手|ぎしゅ} (electric/powered prosthetic hand)

RELATED WORDS:
- {義足|ぎそく}: prosthetic leg
- {義歯|ぎし}: false teeth, dentures
- {義眼|ぎがん}: artificial eye
